cause: The 32nd-power shoulder blend concentrated the height change beside the lid. Independent longitudinal hood/wing sections disagreed at the outer join; fixed-Y finite differences at the rolled wing's square-root limit additionally produced sqrt(slope), rather than the actual along-wing slope, in its normal. Prior tests covered the lid seam and central sections but missed this outer join.
correction: A broad shoulder blend follows the wing height at the same longitudinal position, preserves the front tangent and fitted cowl edge, and meets a coherent upper-quarter profile. More transverse samples retain the fair strip. A transported derivative and analytic top limit give the rolled wing its proper shading normal. The upper nose skin reaches the new shared boundary.
initial_issues: The first added monotonicity check passed the rejected model; a steep but monotonic crease needs actual transverse angle and outer-join gates, now retained with the failing baseline.
Widening the blend alone softened the dent but retained the outer tangent mismatch; that intermediate source/captures remain.
Matching the old lower wing height caused an S turn in the retained x=0.65 profile. A coherent upper-quarter profile fixes it without weakening the original one-degree bound.
The new upper nose exceeded the old 0.90m skin-row cap; native review caught the opening and its bound was corrected before final validation.

Outer-join collection initially expected UV=1 on clamped duplicate vertices. It now selects the actual physical top boundary, preserving the one-millimetre/six-degree gates and requiring the populated 40/20 samples.
limitations: Reload and owner/device appearance, motion and rendering-cost acceptance remain.
Desktop Mobile is PC Vulkan. Manual-stepping race-hitch messages are not a frame-pacing measurement.
No physical-device attachment check/test, APK, purchase, live mutation, deployment or owner-process restart.
Concurrent electric handling/configuration and Garage work are preserved and excluded; root document snapshots isolate this task's edits.
